name: ai-hedge-fund-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is ai-hedge-fund (the `aihf` distribution, package `hedge_fund/`): an
AI-powered hedge-fund engine whose funds blend LLM investor-persona agents and quant alpha models into
target books, apply risk limits, size orders through a simulated broker, and run one cycle or a backtest
from a YAML mandate, through the `aihf` command line or an interactive Textual app. It also ships a
cached Financial Datasets client, LLM provider clients with a prompt cache, a fundamentals snapshot,
a per-model backtesting engine and an event-study tool.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the hedge_fund package (its data clients and cache, alpha models and LLM agents, LLM clients and prompt cache, features, fund and strategy specifications, portfolio construction, risk limits, brokers, cycle pipeline, backtesting, event study and terminal app, and the `aihf` command line; the terminal app's stylesheet and the upstream unit tests are not), together with README.md, ROADMAP.md, VISION.md, hedge_fund/README.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the package.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package c
